column4: Ow! Ha! Dude, these actors are so real!
Imagine you work at a haunted house on Halloween night...
the exact night the zombie apocalypse begins.
You're in full zombie makeup. Your whole job is to jump out and scream.
Braaaains!
Lame.
But tonight, the new actors are different.
They don't blink. They don't take breaks. And they're biting the customers.
Five stars! Best haunted house ever!
Nobody runs. Everyone thinks it's part of the show.
So you sneak out the back door... and the whole town is screaming.
A real zombie walks right up to you. It sniffs you...
and walks away.
Your makeup is so good, they think you're one of them.
Oh. My. God.
So you run back inside, and tell the last guests it's the grand finale.
Single file, folks! Groan if you love Halloween!
Uuuuurgh!
And you lead them, groaning, straight through the horde, to the army trucks.
You made it. And then... it starts to rain.
Would you have survived? Subscribe for more.
